title: MI60037: Petroleum And Mineral Trade
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

National petroleum and mineral policy, reserve production relationship, demand,
supply, market structure and price, Investment, uncertainty, risk and
ownership. Maritime trade, Product ordering, retailing, delivery and payment
models, collusion and embargo in mineral and petroleum market, cartel price,
optimal policy determination. Stockpiling and dumping; introduction to
commodity future, business finance, insurance, taxation. business values and
ethics.
